description: This Java source file defines a class 'ParameterListInclusionStrategy' implementing the 'ExclusionStrategy' interface from Gson library, used to determine which JSON fields to include or exclude based on a set of parameter names.

classes.name: ParameterListInclusionStrategy
classes.description: A class implementing Gson's ExclusionStrategy to include only specified fields during JSON serialization.

methods.name: ParameterListInclusionStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the set of parameter names to include.

methods.name: shouldSkipField
methods.description: Determines whether a field should be skipped based on its name and the inclusion set.

methods.name: shouldSkipClass
methods.description: Indicates whether an entire class should be skipped; always returns false in this implementation.
